speaker: YOU
text: I opened my locker... and ten thousand dollars fell out.

speaker: YOU
text: No note. No name. Just cash.

speaker: FRIEND
text: Bro. That's ten racks. Keep it.

speaker: YOU
text: And honestly? I wanted to.

speaker: YOU
text: My mom works two jobs. Our rent was three weeks late.

speaker: MOM
text: Please... I just need one more week.

speaker: YOU
text: Ten thousand dollars would fix everything.

speaker: YOU
text: So I hid it under my bed.

speaker: YOU
text: But every night, I couldn't sleep. It wasn't mine.

speaker: YOU
text: Three days later, I walked into the principal's office and put it on his desk.

speaker: PRINCIPAL
text: Son... do you know how much money this is?

speaker: YOU
text: Yeah. That's why I'm giving it back.

speaker: YOU
text: That night, someone knocked on our door.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: You're the only one who gave it back.

speaker: YOU
text: The only one?

speaker: OLD MAN
text: I hid ten thousand dollars in fifty lockers across the city. Forty-nine kids kept it.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: I've been looking for someone honest to leave everything to.

speaker: MOM
text: ...Dad?

speaker: YOU
text: The old man was the grandpa I'd never met.

speaker: YOU
text: They hadn't spoken in sixteen years.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: I was wrong about a lot of things. I wasn't wrong about him.

speaker: YOU
text: We never paid rent late again.
